hana: Quick interludemeet Pippin. He commandeered the sink, boarded the rubber boat, and declared it a 'conference call cruise.' Photo: https://imgur.com/a/pippin-boat :boat: :corgi:
samir: absolutely regal. also impressed he negotiated the lifejacket. what are his rider requirements? :joy: :life_preserver:
lucy: He looks like he runs the UX team now. tiny paw on the bow = stakeholder confidence. :clap: :sparkles:
hana: No lifejacket actually, just a ribbon. He insists on the captain hat which he accepts in exchange for treats. Camera: `iPhone 13, Live Photo, 1/120s` window light + slight crop.
kevin: Can we get Pippin as the mascot for "meeting-free Mondays"? He looks like he refuses to attend standups unless snacks are provided. :calendar: :cookie:
ops-bot: Reminder: Pets should be supervised in common areas. See pets policy: https://intranet/company/pets-policy. Facilities will provide a shallow tub for supervised water play upon request. :information_source:
samir: Requesting the tub for Friday chill zone. Pippin can host an "Office Float" session. 10am for low-impact brainstorming. Who's in? :raised_hands:
lucy: In. Will provide tiny flag-making supplies so he can captain our sprint board. :triangular_flag_on_post:
hana: Also note: Pippin politely barks at notifications he doesn't like. If your laptop buzzes, he will judge it. Consider muting. :laughing:
kevin: Proposing sticker idea: "Pippin Approved" for PRs that don't break staging. samir, lucy want to collab on designs?
samir: yes. also merch idea: a plush boat with a corgi. danger: I will purchase in bulk. :money_mouth_face:
lucy: Poll: Make Pippin honorary mascot for ad-hoc morale events? React with :corgi: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. Current tally: hana :corgi:, samir :corgi:, lucy :corgi:, kevin :corgi:. unanimous so far.
hana: tiny logistics: if you want to pet Pippin, please wash hands first (he's got a thing for crumbs). He accepts boops and quiet ball throws. Do not feed bacon without express consent. :peach: :no_entry_sign: :bacon:
ops-bot: Facilities note: Please keep the sink area clear and wipe surfaces after supervised play. Thanks!
